Messages.Author: Tendoncutter
Messages.Body:
Greetings.

I am in the proces of building a Kiasyd deck and I am debating whether to use The Arcadian or Quincy the Trapper.

The problem is I am not sure how the Qiuncy ability works, as the wording is hard to comprehend:

Name: Quincy, The Trapper
[LoB:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Kiasyd
Group: 3
Capacity: 4
Discipline: dom myt obt
Sabbat: Quincy may burn an ally controlled by your predator or prey with two +1 stealth  actions. Cold iron vulnerability.
Artist: Mark Nelson

How does his ability work? Is it possible for him to take two actions in one turn, as long as they are directed at burning an ally controlled by predator or prey? Does he tap and then untap, between each action? Do they happen simoultaneously? Or can the action only be directed at one ally, but happens twice, in case the first one is blocked?

The ability sounds very neat, especially in taking care of garou rushers and intercept allies etc. I'm just not sure how it works or how we are supposed to interpret an action that gives two actions?

I've tried using the search function to find anything about him, but seemingly get nothing.

Cheers
/Tendon

Messages.Author: ur_vampire
Messages.Body:
I read the card as follow: Quincy has to take 2 actions, but you can make only one in a turn, so it takes 2 turns to burn the ally

Cheers
Richard

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: That card should probably be rewritten to use tokens of sort. The game state should always be visible on the table, without having to remember the previous turns.

Messages.Author: kushiel23
Messages.Body:
> Tendoncutter wrote:
> So the reasoning is that vampires can only take one action a turn, and thus Quincy's ability must be done over two turns?
>
No. There's nothing limiting vampires to only taking one action per turn. However, the No Repeat Actions rule prevents a minion from taking the same action more than once per turn (with the exception of hunting, or action cards which specifically state that they can be taken more than once per turn).
